risk_if_not_implemented: Without HVA / crown jewels protections, residual security, compliance, or resilience risk may accumulate without structured oversight, leading to unmanaged exposures.

compensating_control_1.name: Asset Inventories
compensating_control_1.justification: Asset Inventories (AST-02) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Crown Jewels (GOV-21) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Ranking
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and assign a risk ranking to newly discovered security vulnerabilities that is based on industry-recognized practices.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Ranking (RSK-05) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Crown Jewels (GOV-21) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
